commentary.text: Verdict: Restructure. Taif Central Engineering on the asked structure was run through 38 scenarios across 6 families; 25 break a test. Before any stress the structure already fails the RAROC hurdle, so it cannot be recommended as asked. The drivers are pricing (RAROC below the hurdle before stress), revenue, largest-customer concentration and project delays. RAROC is below the hurdle before any downgrade; breaks a covenant at −8% revenue. The combined severe case (oil, rates, sector, collateral and revenue together) gives DSCR 0.49x, Stage 2 and RAROC 6.1% against 16.0%. At three notches down the checked RAROC is 11.0% (PD, capital, ECL and pricing re-priced at B), from 13.0% today. What to do: restructure before committee; protect it with a higher margin or fees, or security that lowers the capital charge and a DSCR covenant with a cash sweep, a shorter tenor or a lower amount. Monitoring tier High, review every 3 months, with 4 named triggers (Operating inflows down 5% or more on the year; Largest customer share above 40%). 1 scenario does not apply to this deal and is shown as such. Base: DSCR 1.37x, rating BB, RAROC 13.0%.
